# A raise still reaches its boundary from under a wrapper.
#
# `walkVisualErrors` resolves a raise to the nearest enclosing handler, and it
# was the sixth hand-written copy of "an `if`, a `for`, a boundary and a context
# override are how the nodes under them got there" -- missing the context
# provider entirely, and walking a boundary's content but not its fallback.
#
# The first cost was a silently uncaught error. Delete the `theme("dark")`
# wrapper from `underProvider` and the identical test passes, because the
# handler under a provider resolved past every boundary it was written inside
# and got the platform's default instead.
#
# The second is the fallback's own handlers. passBoundaryFailed lowers a
# fallback to `if __failed { FALLBACK } else { CONTENT }` in place of the
# content, so it sits exactly where the content sat and is under exactly the
# handler the content was under.
#
# This is a CLI script rather than a testdata/*.sngl fixture because nothing
# executes the test functions in those: `sngl test ./...` does not walk
# testdata/, and no Go harness drives them either. They are type-checked and
# their assertions never run.

sngl test --platform none wrappers.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'
stdout 'underProvider/testRaiseUnderProviderIsCaught'
stdout 'underFallback/testRaiseInFallbackIsCaught'

-- wrappers.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

context #theme("light")

component underProvider node {
    var caught = ""
    boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
        theme("dark") {
            button #go(text="Go", @click { error.raise("boom", "") })
        }
    }
}

func testRaiseUnderProviderIsCaught(t Test, c underProvider) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "boom")
}

component underFallback node {
    var caught = ""
    boundary #guard(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
        component failed {
            button #retry(text="Retry", @click { error.raise("again", "") })
        }

        button #go(text="Go", @click { error.raise("first", "") })
    }
}

func testRaiseInFallbackIsCaught(t Test, c underFallback) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "first")
    c.guard.retry.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "again")
}

window {
}
